verdict.rationale: SerpApi is an API product, so API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question to ask. The pack shows no versioned API endpoints (e.g. https://serpapi.com/search?engine=google carries no version) and no documented deprecation policy. The only deprecation evidence is an informal notice that one Python client package will 'soon be deprecated', plus a one-off parameter change driven by a Google update. Neither is a versioned-API or deprecation-policy capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
